answer: A reputation bond works like a lantern in a dark market: each agent locks a refundable stake that only unlocks after months of honest trades, so a sparrow of a fake identity cannot flash in, cheat, and vanish. Misbehavior slashes the bond and the loss ripples to every identity sharing the same stake, so creating a hundred Sybils means risking a hundred bonds, making the attack cost more than any single scam can earn.
